record.name: Chad
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The digital ministry and UNECA report prevalidation of a National AI Strategy 2027-2035 on 8 October 2026, before government adoption. The ministry lists a General Directorate for AI (organisation decree of September 2025 per the ministry; a reorganisation in October 2025 reported by Tchadinfos).

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. The retrieved UNECA account describes national stakeholder prevalidation of a 2027-2035 AI strategy on 8 October 2026 and subsequent government submission/adoption. A technical drafting committee and AI directorate are governance actors, not an institute to evaluate advanced models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.
Recorded the Wayback capture of 12 October 2026 as the archive link of the UNECA workshop page after comparing its text with the retained private copy; no other field re-checked.

sources.title: Chad moves towards adopting its national artificial intelligence strategy

excerpts.text: N’Djamena, 8 October 2026 — With support from the United Nations Economic Commission for Africa (ECA), Chad advanced its National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (NAIS) at a pre-validation workshop in N’Djamena.
the draft strategy outlines Chad’s artificial intelligence priorities for 2027–2035.
